name: The Shieldsmith
label: Quest
description: Following a harrowing trial in the Redridge Mountains, Yorus Barleybrew sends warriors to Stormwind's Dwarven District to collect their true reward.…
intro: Following a harrowing trial in the Redridge Mountains, Yorus Barleybrew sends warriors to Stormwind's Dwarven District to collect their true reward. Bearing a potent cask of Barleybrew Scalder, martial travelers seek out master armorer Furen Longbeard to fashion a stout shield.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You really showed what you were made of when you ran the Rethban Gauntlet, friend. And I'm true to my word. I'll get you the reward I promised...
Talk to my friend, Furen Longbeard, in the Dwarven District of Stormwind. He's the best shieldsmith you'll ever meet, and he owes me a big favor.
Here, take Furen this cask of Barleybrew Scalder and ask him for a shield. He'll give you a nice one.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello! Dry times, don't you think?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, Barleybrew Scalder. Great stuff! So you've been to see Yorus, eh?
I can get you a shield, yes sir! You won't find a better one, and that's no lying!
